analysis.title: GS Novak - GS U.S. Industrials & Materials after hours 29 Oct 2026
key_insights: Desk wrap for 10/29/26: industrials closed up 100bps at session highs and materials were similarly strong, while the broader market fell 30bps, weighed by technology.
Defense, aerospace and airlines were strong after earnings. Data center names lagged notably.
By factor, levered names and beta outperformed and momentum was sharply lower.
A benign PCE print pushed rates lower, with the 10-year at 4.95%, which helped rate-sensitive equities.
Next session: Chicago PMI is the macro event. AN, CNI, GD, GTES, LEA, LYB, MGA, NVT, RBC, SXT and TILE report pre-market. IR, FDXF, MTZ and MHK are the most debated post-market reports.

Client questions (inbounds) cover whether the UPS follow-through has legs, CP weakness on big volume despite an in-line quarter, broad LTL weakness, and whether DHI is being viewed as a clearing event.

Other inbounds: CSL strength despite a mixed report, LKQ strength, the size of the LHX move despite a small margin cut to 2028, ARXS lack of reaction, TXT strength versus implied Q4, and the probability of a management change at HONA.

Other inbounds: AGCO early order commentary is very narrow and implies a weak Q4, yet the stock reacted. Also CAT risk/reward, where the bar is on IR, whether CARR is derisked, and whether people realize GVA guided nearly 50% ahead of the Street in the out year.
Post-market guidance below consensus: MHK Q4 EPS $1.35-1.45 vs. $1.64 consensus, TFII Q4 below $1.30-1.40 vs. $1.66, and OLN Q4 EBITDA $80-100mm vs. $116mm consensus.
OLN cited elevated destocking and higher feedstock costs for its Q4 guide.
IR beat on Q3 EPS and EBITDA and raised its full-year EPS ex tariff and revenue growth ranges. The desk notes the quarter was in line ex tariff refunds.
MHK announced a strategic and capital allocation framework with a new $500mm share repurchase authorization, alongside the weak Q4 guide.
RIVN beat on loss per share, EBITDA loss and production, and narrowed its full-year EBITDA loss, citing regulatory credits, IEEPA and higher deliveries.
SNDR announced a deal with NSC to expand intermodal capacity in the East and lowered its capex range.
Post-market implied moves are largest for MTZ (11%), SNDR (11%), MHK (10%) and RIVN (10%).
Upcoming GS events include the GS Industrials and Materials Conference on 12/2-12/3/26 and a 11/17/26 SuperCompute session with CARR, DOV, ETN, ECL, FLEX, NVT and VRT.
earnings_insights: CVLG Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $0.50 vs. $0.43 consensus, revenue $354mm vs. $337mm, EBIT $16mm vs. $15mm. Call 10am with a 3% implied move. Desk calls it Baird's favorite.

EMN Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $1.84 vs. $1.92 consensus (miss), sales $2.4bn in line, EBIT $305mm vs. $312mm. Advanced Materials missed sales and beat EBIT, Additives and Functional Products had in-line sales and an EBIT miss, Chemical Intermediates missed sales with lower EBIT. Full-year EPS guide $6-6.20 vs. $6.31 consensus, operating cash flow $850mm. Call 8am with a 5% implied move.

IR Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $1.07 vs. $0.90 consensus, revenue $2.06bn vs. $2.05bn, EBITDA $584mm vs. $552mm. In line ex tariff refunds. Raised guide: EPS ex tariff $3.58-3.70 vs. $3.45-3.57 prior, revenue growth 5.5-7% vs. 4.5-6.5% prior, EBITDA ex $2.13-2.19bn. Call 8am with a 7% implied move.

MHK Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $2.72 vs. $2.58 consensus, sales $2.8bn vs. $2.82bn. Global Ceramic in-line sales and EBIT miss, Flooring NA topline miss with small EBIT beat, Flooring ROW topline miss with big margin beat. Q4 EPS guide $1.35-1.45 vs. $1.64 consensus. New $500mm buyback. Call 11am with a 10% implied move.

MTZ Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EBITDA $486mm vs. $476mm consensus, sales $5.2bn vs. $4.94bn, EPS in line. Comms and Clean Energy missed, Power beat on topline and EBITDA, Pipeline revenue ahead with EBITDA and margins below. Full-year EBITDA guide $1.57-1.60bn vs. $1.60bn consensus, EPS $8.92-9.30 vs. $9.30 prior, revenue $18.3bn vs. $18.20bn prior. Call 9am with an 11% implied move.

OLN Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EBITDA $191mm vs. $181mm consensus, revenue $1.75bn vs. $1.81bn (light). Q4 EBITDA guide $80-100mm vs. $116mm consensus on elevated destocking and higher feedstock costs. Call 10am with a 5% implied move.

RIVN Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): revenue $2.16bn vs. $2bn consensus, loss per share 48c vs. 61c consensus, production 19,751 ahead of consensus, EBITDA loss $435mm vs. $586mm consensus. Full-year EBITDA loss guide $1.8bn vs. $1.9bn prior, deliveries 67-70k, capex $1.4-1.5bn. Call 5pm with a 10% implied move.

RSG Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $1.94 vs. $1.93 consensus, revenue $4.56bn vs. $4.42bn, EBITDA $1.45bn in line. Raised full-year revenue guide to $17.425-17.475bn vs. $17.05-17.15bn prior and EBITDA to $5.55-5.575bn vs. $5.475-5.552bn prior. Call 5pm with a 2% implied move.
SKYW Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $3.08 vs. $3.45 consensus (miss), revenue $1.12bn vs. $1.14bn consensus, EBIT $176mm vs. $181mm. Call 4:30pm with a 7% implied move.

SNDR Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $0.29 in line, revenue $1.6bn vs. $1.57bn. Full-year EPS guide $1-1.10 vs. $0.90-1.1 prior, capex $325-350mm vs. $350-400mm prior. NSC intermodal capacity deal. Call 4:30pm with an 11% implied move.

SPXC Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $2.21 vs. $2.12 consensus, revenue $715mm vs. $710mm, EBIT $157mm vs. $150mm. HVAC beat topline but missed margins, Detection and Measurement beat topline and margins. Full-year revenue $2.745-2.805bn, EPS $8.20-8.50, EBITDA $625-645mm vs. $630-660mm prior. Call 4:45pm with a 6% implied move.

TFII Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $1.67 vs. $1.75 consensus (miss), revenue $2.23bn vs. $2.24bn, EBITDA $340mm vs. $351mm. Q4 EPS guide below $1.30-1.40 vs. $1.66 consensus. LTL revenue and EBITDA missed, Truckload very slightly below, Logistics beat across the board. Call 8:30am with a 4% implied move.

VLTO Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EPS $1.18 vs. $1.09 consensus, sales $1.5bn in line. Q4 EPS guide $1.13-1.16 vs. $1.13 consensus on core sales growth of 5.5-6.5% and operating margin of 24.5%. Raised full-year core sales growth to 4.2-4.5% and EPS to $4.49-4.52 vs. $4.35-4.43 prior. Call 7:30am with a 5% implied move.
WY Q3 (reported 10/29 post-market): EBITDA $248mm vs. $256mm consensus (miss), sales $1.9bn in line, EPS 8c vs. 4c consensus. Call 10am with a 2% implied move.
